algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve#: A timed-out evaluation kept the only worker thread busy, so every program after it timed out too. Timeouts now get a fresh executor.
StarTrail-org/LEANN#480: Metadata-filtered search could return fewer than top_k results, or none. The search now widens its candidate pool until enough results match.
algorithmicsuperintelligence/openevolve#: Resuming from a checkpoint path that didn't exist silently started a fresh run. It now raises, so a typo in the path can't quietly restart a long run from scratch.
posit-dev/pointblank#593: On PyArrow tables, segments= didn't filter, so every segment was checked against all rows, and segments='col' and pre= errored. All three now behave as on pandas and Polars.
pydata/xarray#11939: python-xxhash 4 broke the minimum-versions CI job for every PR. Pinned it there so the job tests the oldest supported versions again.
